title: The Perfect PA - For PAs & Executive Secretaries
overview: In today's business landscape, executive assistants play a crucial and influential role, requiring them to establish a strong partnership with the senior management team. This course aims to equip you with the essential competencies to effectively collaborate with your manager. Recognizing that your success directly impacts your manager's success, the course aims to enhance your existing skill set by incorporating additional competencies essential for excellence in your role
audience: Experienced senior administrators, office managers, executive assistants, and supervisors overseeing junior staff members, all of whom possess fundamental administrative skills and aspire to advance their professional careers
methodology: This course is designed to be extremely interactive, incorporating numerous group and individual role plays. Participants will be actively involved in practical group and individual activities, providing immediate opportunities to test and apply their learning. Additionally, various self-assessment tests will be employed to help participants uncover their hidden talents and identify areas for improvement
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Offer comprehensive support to stakeholders to elevate business success
Apply emotional intelligence to cultivate strong business relationships horizontally and vertically
Utilize contemporary communication concepts and strategies to streamline workflow
Leverage key management functions to establish and sustain diverse organizational systems for enhanced productivity
Demonstrate professional competence in creativity, serving internal customers, and stress management
